page: UpCloud GPU-96xCPU-960GB-4xB200 is a GPU-accelerated virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 96 shared vCPUs and 960.0 GB of system memory, providing 10.0 GB of RAM per core. The server is equipped with four NVIDIA B200 GPUs from the Blackwell family, delivering a combined 768 GB of high-bandwidth video memory.

This configuration does not include local storage, meaning storage must be attached externally. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. The shared CPU allocation model represents a resource tradeoff, as CPU cycles are shared with other tenants, though the massive GPU and system memory footprint remains dedicated to heavy parallel processing workloads.

Given the presence of four Blackwell-generation NVIDIA B200 GPUs and 960 GB of system RAM, this server is designed for massive parallel computing tasks. It is highly suited for large language model training, complex deep learning workloads, high-performance computing simulations, and large-scale data science jobs.
